labelsets.name: subclass
labelsets.description: The coarse level of cell type definition in the mouse whole brain taxonomy. All cells within a supertype belong to the same subclass. Subclass groups together related supertypes.

labelsets.name: supertype
labelsets.description: The second finest level of cell type definition in the mouse whole brain taxonomy. All cells within a cluster belong to the same supertype. Supertype groups together similar clusters.

labels.name: 1184 MOL NN_4
labels.rationale: Mapping of this cell set to a mature myelinating oligodendrocyte is supported by spatial transcriptomic evidence and specific expression of Klk6 in the context of oligodendrocyte lineage cells.

labels.name: 1181 COP NN_1
labels.rationale: Mapping of this cell set to a differentiation-committed oligodendrocyte is supported by spatial transcriptomic evidence and specific expression of Gpr17, Bmp4, Neu4, Fyn in the context of oligodendrocyte lineage cells.

labels.name: 1182 NFOL NN_2
labels.rationale: Mapping of this cell set to a newly formed oligodendrocyte is supported by spatial transcriptomic evidence and specific expression of Tcf7l2, Klk6, Cemip2, Casr in the context of oligodendrocyte lineage cells.

labels.name: 1183 MFOL NN_3
labels.rationale: Mapping of this cell set to a myelin-forming oligodendrocyte is supported by spatial transcriptomic evidence and specific expression of Ctps, Cldn11 in the context of oligodendrocyte lineage cells.

labelsets.name: class
labelsets.description: The top level of cell type definition in the mouse whole brain taxonomy. It is primarily determined by broad brain region and neurotransmitter type. All cells within a subclass belong to the same class. Class provides a broader categorization of cell types.

labelsets.name: cluster
labelsets.description: The finest level of cell type definition in the mouse whole brain taxonomy. Cells within a cluster share similar characteristics and belong to the same supertype.

labels.name: 4606 Pineal Crx Glut_1
labels.rationale: Consistent with this cell set being composed of Pinealocytes, a combination of Pinealocyte markers Gngt1 and Crx can identify the cells in this cluster with a confidence (F-beta score) of 0.91 in the context of glutamatergic cells (Pinealocytes release glutamate) from the hippocampal formation dissection (which includes the pineal gland).	https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1600-079x.1996.tb00284.x,https://doi.org/10.3389/fendo.2019.00590	Crx|Gngt1|Tph1|Asmt|Gngt2

labels.name: 5243 Tanycyte NN_1
labels.rationale: Mapping to tanycyte of subfornical organ based on spatial transcriptomics evidence.

labels.name: 5263 Hypendymal NN_1
labels.rationale: Mapping of this cell set to the hypendemal cell type is supported by its location to the subcommisural organ (from spatial transcriptomics), its expression of Sspo and its general transcriptomic classification in a class (Astro-Epen) along with epdendymal cells, tanycytes and astrocytes.
